26 Swiss Re Institute sigma No 1/2025  
Number of catastrophic events: 336
In terms of sigma criteria, there were 336 catastrophes worldwide in 2024, up from 334 
in 2023. There were 228 natural catastrophes (up from 219 in 2023), and 108 man-
made disasters (down from 115 in 2023). 
Number of victims: 14 083
Worldwide, 14 083 people are believed to have died or gone missing in disaster events 
in 2024. Natural catastrophes claimed 10 822 victims. Man-made disasters claimed a 
further 3 261 victims.
